name: Pudukkottai City Municipal Corporation
description: G.O. Ms. No. 104 constituted the corporation with effect from 12 August 2024. The former Pudukkottai Municipality, Kaspa Forest (West) and eight village panchayats entered in full: Thirukkattalai, Thirumalairaya Samuthiram, Kavinadu East, Kavinadu West, 9-A Natham Pannai, 9-B Natham Pannai, Vagavasal and Mullur.
